strings.دروس تشطيب البيت في الكويت 7: وثّق الأعم: Home finishing lessons in Kuwait 7: document concealed work before closing
strings.بعد تركيب الكسوة أو إغلاق السقف، يصير ال: Access behind cladding or a closed ceiling differs from access during installation. Establish a clear inspection stage before closure. In lesson seven of the Almusaileem series, collect records showing what was reviewed, what remains unresolved and who authorised progress to the next finishing stage.
strings.تصميم توضيحي لسقف جبس بورد أثناء التجهيز: Explanatory design of gypsum board roof during processing with metal structure and revision hole
strings.تصميم توضيحي مولّد بالذكاء الاصطناعي، ول: AI-generated illustration, not a photograph of a completed Almusaileem project.
strings.جهّز مخططات الخدمات المحدثة، قائمة التغي: Prepare updated service plans, list of changes, and names of those responsible for implementation and inspection. The resulting file for each region includes its reports, photos, observations and the status of allowing coverage. The timing and scope of the tests is determined by the specialist according to the system and the circumstances of the project. This lesson organizes your follow-up; adoption of safety or adequacy of the test needs the specialist in charge, not evaluating the image with the owner of the house.
strings.اسأل المشرف أي أجزاء يجب أن تبقى ظاهرة ح: Ask the supervisor which parts should remain visible until you check, who is requesting the scan, who is attending it and who is recording the result. Link the answer to a specific area: ceiling hall, bathroom wall, or screen wall. The phrase “services completed” indicates whether the whole area is ready or if a part remains unaudited.
strings.خطة الإغلاق تختلف حسب الأعمال؛ قد تجهز م: The closure plan varies depending on the business; one area may be prepared while another remains pending. This difference is clearly recorded so that no room approval is passed on to the rest of the house.
strings.كمرجع عام لتنظيم المهام وتبادل المعلومات: As a general reference for organizing tasks and exchanging information between phases of the project, with details of examination and acceptance still linked to your project.
strings.اجمع تقريرًا مفهومًا مع الصور: Compile a report with the pictures.
strings.اطلب سجل الفحص أو الاختبار الذي يناسب ال: Ask the specialist for the inspection or test record appropriate to the work: what was checked, where, when, with what result, and who performed and reviewed it. For defects or unacceptable results, request the corrective action and reinspection record. The word “done” alone is insufficient; do not carry out electrical, pressure or other specialist tests yourself.
strings.اطلب صورًا عامة تبين مكان العمل، ثم صورً: Ask for general photos showing the work place, and then images closer to the important details, with the name of the room and the date of filming. Link them to an updated outline of the tracks actually executed, kept by the project officer. Photos and records help in follow-up and maintenance, but they do not replace the identification of tracks on the ground by the specialist before any excavation or subsequent installation.
strings.راجع الوصول للصيانة قبل الشكل النهائي: Check access for maintenance before final form
strings.ناقش فتحات الصيانة والعناصر التي تحتاج و: Discuss the maintenance access panels and elements that need future access with service and decoration specialists together. Ask if the door, cabinet or cladding will block the desired access, and if the hole is clearly located in the finishing details. Do not assume that an opening on the drawing is sufficient without reviewing what will be installed around.
strings.في مثال تعليمي، قد يتغير تصميم خزانة تحت: In a tutorial example, the layout of a cabinet under the screen may change and cover where access is to the devices. This relationship is best resolved before implementation, by reference to details
strings.ديكور الشاشة والوصول للأجهزة: Decor screen and access to devices
strings.. كذلك راجع علاقة فتحات الخدمات مع: See also the relationship of service openings with
strings.شلون تقفل الملاحظة؟: How do you lock the note?
strings.اكتب لكل ملاحظة موقعًا ووصفًا ومسؤولًا و: Record each defect’s location, description, responsible party and status: open, corrected and awaiting verification, or closed after review. If previously inspected work changes, ask the specialist which checks must be repeated. Retain the agreed responsible person’s permission to cover the work, with its date and applicable area.
strings.مو كل صورة جديدة تعني أن الملاحظة انتهت؛: Not every new image means the note is finished; link the processing image to the appropriate verification result. Ask the finishing team to maintain acceptable work as it moves to the next stage, informing the administrator if damage or modification is needed. This way the area file stays relevant, rather than being a compilation of old images.
strings.حدود المنطقة ونقاط المراجعة معروفة قبل ت: Zone boundaries and review points are known before they are covered.
strings.سجلات الفحوص المطلوبة موجودة مع أسماء ال: The required check records are in place with the names of the officials.
strings.المخططات والصور تعكس المسارات المنفذة وا: Charts and images reflect the tracks implemented and the changes.
strings.فتحات الصيانة منسقة مع الأثاث والجبس وال: maintenance access panels coordinated with furniture, gypsum and cladding.
strings.الملاحظات عولجت وأعيد التحقق منها عند ال: The notes were processed and re-verified when needed.
strings.السماح بالتغطية موثق للمنطقة المعنية بوض: Allowing coverage is clearly documented for the area concerned.
strings.اربط الفحص بموعد أعمال الديكور: Link the inspection to the date of the decoration work
strings.لتنسيق جاهزية المناطق لأعمال الجبس والكس: To coordinate the readiness of areas for gypsum and cladding work, share the chart and status of notes with
